summary: Jeffrey R. Rosinski, 29, of Middletown, RI — died in a fall of up to 300 ft on Longs Peak's Keyhole Route; hiking late and went off-route above the Trough; fell sometime after 7:15 p.m. Thu Jul 15; body found ~3 a.m. Fri Jul 16 by fellow climber Corbin Mabon near the Trough at ~13,000 ft; was with a party of four but separated; rangers notified 5:30 a.m. Fri; body flown to Upper Beaver Meadows helispot and transferred to the Boulder County Coroner.
notes: NPT 2010-07 article corroborates 100summits: 29-yo RI man, 250-300 ft fall near the Trough/Ledges; identity was withheld pending notification when NPT reported. Merge run 441: Boulder Weekly July-2010 police blotter (opened) corroborates the Rosinski facts — body of 29-YO Jeffrey R. Rosinski of Rhode Island, ~300-ft fall ~150 yds SW of the Keyhole Route in harsh winds, found early morning July 16, flown to the Boulder County Coroner. NPS July 19, 2010 morning report: body found the morning of Friday, July 16 along the Keyhole Route between The Trough and The Ledges, 250-300 ft fall Thursday evening after separating from the party camped at the Boulderfield; body flown to Upper Beaver Meadows helispot, transferred to the Boulder County Coroner. | run-694 merge: romo.htm 'Rhode Island Man Killed In Fall On Longs Peak' (report 2010-07-19: 29-yr-old RI man, body found Jul 16 Keyhole Route ~13,000 ft, 250-300 ft fall).
